headline: Ramayana is expected to close today near 1.29M tickets, with a peak of about 104K at 10–11 PM and Friday likely stronger.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana has 331K tickets so far and is at 54.9K now, up 281% vs yesterday; its day total is expected around 1.29M (range 1.08M to 1.55M).
Its busiest hour still ahead is likely 10–11 PM at about 104K (range 66.8K to 146K), while the next hours are estimated at 52.1K, 49.2K and 57.1K.
Tomorrow, Friday with new releases opening, could bring Ramayana to about 1.37M (range 1.03M to 2.13M), and Diwali on 2026-11-08 is coming soon.
Jailer 2 is expected to reach 22.1K today (range 18.5K to 26.4K), down 35% vs yesterday, and Aadarsha Kutumbam is down 3% vs yesterday with a 10–11 PM peak near 2.9K.
watch: Review and word-of-mouth signals are not included yet, so these estimates rest on booking patterns alone.
Friday's new releases and the run-up to Diwali could shift Ramayana's opening-weekend numbers in either direction.
